statement.excerpt: The future I am talking about — one where most data center debt goes unpaid, where OpenAI and Anthropic fail to meet their obligations, and when AI GPU sales grind to a halt — involves Google, Microsoft and Amazon having catastrophic misses on their earnings expectations, and their future revenue growth stories collapsing, along with NVIDIA’s revenues dropping as much as 90% once the debt-backed AI capex boom ends.

our_interpretation: Treat the described collapse as a joint antecedent, not as an event assumed to have happened.
Most debt means a majority by amount of the relevant data-center debt, rather than a majority of borrowers.
Payment failures mean documented failures to meet contractual obligations; falling stock prices or expensive borrowing do not suffice.
Catastrophic earnings misses means severe misses against forecasts recorded before the results. No numerical cutoff is supplied.
As much as 90% is an upper-bound scenario, not a promise of an exact 90% decline or a requirement for at least a 90% decline.
Revenue means realized consolidated revenue. The baseline, measurement interval, and accounting basis are unspecified.
No deadline is assigned to this sentence. The following sentence's next-few-years wording is not automatically imported.
criteria.support_condition: After the full antecedent is documented, comparable records show severe earnings misses and a collapse in expected revenue growth at all three hyperscalers, together with a substantial decline in NVIDIA revenue consistent with the stated scenario.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the full antecedent, sufficiently sustained comparable results show the predicted company-wide earnings and revenue damage does not occur. An exact 90% fall is not required, so a smaller decline alone is not a contradiction.
